overview: The Wausau Common Council was unable to hold its regularly scheduled meeting due to a lack of quorum — fewer than the required eight members were present due to last-minute call-ins. Instead, the council held an informal presentation to honor Sheryl Bahr (referred to as 'Cheryl Barr' on her certificate) for 28 years of service on the Wausau Police and Fire Commission, from 1998 to 2026. No official council business was conducted and no votes were taken.

agenda.item: Announcement that quorum was not met and regular meeting would not be called to order
Informal retirement presentation honoring Sheryl Bahr for 28 years on the Wausau Police and Fire Commission
Historical context remarks by Mayor Diny about 1998, the year Bahr joined the commission
Remarks by Police Chief Matt Barnes
Presentation of commemorative certificate and plaque to Sheryl Bahr

discussions.body: Mayor Diny opened by announcing that due to last-minute call-ins, the council did not have the required quorum of eight members and therefore the regular Common Council meeting would not be called to order. No official business was transacted.

Mayor Diny provided historical context about Wausau in 1998 when Bahr joined the Police and Fire Commission. Police Chief Matt Barnes spoke, noting that every sworn member of the Wausau Police Department — including himself — had been interviewed by Bahr, and praised her ability to put candidates at ease. The fire chief also spoke, noting that Bahr had participated in interviews for nearly every member of the fire department as well as all promotions in both departments, emphasizing her attentiveness and follow-up questions. Bahr received a certificate of recognition and a plaque and offered brief remarks praising Wausau as 'one of the greatest cities in the United States' and lauding the integrity of the police and fire departments.

Mayor Diny read aloud the certificate: 'City of Wausau, Wisconsin recognizes Cheryl Bar in recognition and appreciation of your leadership, insight, and dedication as a commissioner of the Wausau Police and Fire Commission from 1998 to 2026.' A plaque and a signed card from fire department members were also presented. The event concluded with applause and the informal meeting was adjourned.

actionItems: No official action items — meeting did not achieve quorum and no formal business was conducted
title: Wausau Presentation
